question.text: 'Saksham Skills Pvt Ltd' is a For Profit Enterprise (FPE) seeking registration on BSE-SSE. For SIA assessment of primacy of social intent under SEBI ICDR Regulations, what minimum threshold of eligible activities directed at the target population must be demonstrated?

answer.text: At least 50% of the immediately preceding 3-year average of revenues, expenditure or beneficiaries
At least 85% of the immediately preceding 3-year average of revenues, expenditure or beneficiaries
At least 75% of the immediately preceding 3-year average of revenues, expenditure or beneficiaries
At least 67% of the immediately preceding 3-year average of revenues, expenditure or beneficiaries

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI ICDR Regulations require an FPE to demonstrate at least 67% of the immediately preceding 3-year average of revenues, expenditure, or beneficiary/customer base directed toward eligible activities to the target population. Any one of the three tests satisfies the threshold. The Trap: 50% is a simple majority and not the SEBI threshold. 85% is the Section 11 income-application threshold under the Income Tax Act for NPOs, not the FPE eligibility threshold. 75% does not match the source. Note: Ask the SE for 3-year audited financials and beneficiary MIS, compute all three ratios, and document which test passed in the working papers so subsequent reviewers can retrace.
